title: A Reason to Live, a Reason to Die
writer: Ernesto Gastaldi, Tonino Valerii, Rafael Azcona
actors: James Coburn, Bud Spencer, Telly Savalas
plot: Branded a coward for surrendering his New Mexico fort to the Confederates without firing a shot, a Union colonel leads a band of condemned prisoners on a suicide mission to recapture it.
